end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets and food chains by sequencing examples and using arrows. Manav correctly ordered grass → deer → lion and later identified grass as a plant. The grass/plant explanation was mixed up at first and clarified later. At home, ask Manav to make two food chains and explain what each arrow means.
